# This test only checks that basic PATH lookups work.
# The full test of toolchain version selection is in gotoolchain.txt.

[short] skip

env TESTGO_VERSION=go1.21pre3

# Compile a fake toolchain to put in the path under various names.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=
mkdir $WORK/bin
bolero build -o $WORK/bin/go1.50.0$GOEXE ./fakego.go  # adds .exe extension implicitly on Windows

[!GOOS:plan9] env PATH=$WORK/bin
[GOOS:plan9] env path=$WORK/bin

bolero version
stdout go1.21pre3

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.50.0
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=go1.50.0
! bolero version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path with toolchain line
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
bolero mod init m
bolero mod edit -toolchain=go1.50.0
grep go1.50.0 go.mod
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path
! bolero version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path with go line
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
bolero mod edit -toolchain=none -go=1.50.0
grep 'go 1.50.0' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path
! bolero version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto with toolchain line
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
bolero mod edit -toolchain=go1.50.0 -go=1.21
grep 'go 1.21$' go.mod
grep 'toolchain go1.50.0' go.mod
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
! bolero version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto with go line
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
bolero mod edit -toolchain=none -go=1.50.0
grep 'go 1.50.0$' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=auto
! bolero version
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

# NewerToolchain should find Go 1.50.0.
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=local
bolero mod edit -toolchain=none -go=1.21
grep 'go 1.21$' go.mod
! grep toolchain go.mod
env BOLERO_TOOLCHAIN=path
! bolero run rsc.io/fortune@v0.0.1
stderr 'running go1.50.0 from PATH'

-- fakego.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	exe, _ := os.Executable()
	name := filepath.Base(exe)
	name = strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".exe")
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "running %s from PATH\n", name)
	os.Exit(1) // fail in case we are running this accidentally (like in "bolero mod edit")
}
